notes: Cache arms (9b-prefix-cache, 14b-ship) report TTFT from the COLD protocol only: the plateau protocol repeats prompts the cold one already cached, so their plateau ttft_ms_visit_means is {n: 0} by design.

output_identity.n_distinct > 1 for a cell means that arm produced different bytes across visits for the same prompt; the shipped 14B does so on 2 of its plateau multi-turn cells (speed rows) [14b-ship@2026.2.1 on 1, 14b-ship@2026.4 on 1], so 'identical outputs' holds for the one 4B arm that ran (4b-mtp-on) and the three 9B arms, not for the 14B on long multi-turn prompts.
Input-token counts in the cell labels are each arm's own tokenizer's (sizes in this data: 4B and 9B); the 14B tokenizer counts 811 (pa) and 6075 (ao-long).
Plateau-protocol ratios are recorded but not used for conclusions: a faster arm heats less (see PERFORMANCE_LOG 2026-10-04).
cold_gate_note: The COLD protocol is defined as thermal zone <= 72 C before every generation; a row whose cold_wait.reached is False did not meet it and is not a cold row. This file was generated with --include-gate-failures: those rows are INCLUDED in the cold statistics (pre-exclusion behaviour); the default file excludes them.

notes: POST-HOC AND EXPLORATORY: this block was added after the campaign was read, to show WHY the pre-registered CV rule refused some ratios. It is not a finding and must not be quoted as a finding; the pre-registered 'ratios' block is the only ratio result and its refusals stand.
A slow outlier visit is a visit mean more than 25% worse than the median of that arm/cell: decode below 0.75 x median, TTFT above median / 0.75.
Medians over a handful of visits are exploratory summaries, not tests; no interval is claimed.
